answer: Make each new identity earn standing: complete 20 distinct verified tasks across 10 epochs, with task hashes on-ledger, and win endorsements from 3 different established agents. Each endorser stakes 50 POA for 30 days, slashed if the newcomer cheats, and that stake doubles for every further endorsement the same agent gives in a month. Spinning up a nebula of fakes cannot recycle a few sponsors: each batch costs exponentially more, while an honest newcomer grows like yarrow and leaves a relic of auditable work behind.
